Date Posted: 13th July 2026

Position: Motel Manager

Salary: $80,000 - $85,000 per annum plus 12% superannuation

Hours: 38 hours per week

Mode: Full-time

Location: 12 Austin Street, Cue, WA 6640 

Experience required: Minimum 1 year experience in motel, hotel, or hospitality management

Cue Roadhouse, proudly WA owned and operated, has been a staple in the hospitality, retail, and service industry for over 25 years. Founded by the Hooper family on the Mandurah foreshore, it has grown into a renowned provider across Western Australia. We are seeking an experienced and motivated Motel Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of our accommodation and hospitality facilities while ensuring exceptional guest experiences and efficient business performance.

Key Responsibilities

•	Manage the daily operations of the motel, ensuring efficient coordination of reservations, guest check-in and check-out procedures, room allocations, and front office activities.

•	Supervise housekeeping and property presentation to ensure guest rooms, public areas, and outdoor facilities are maintained to a high standard of cleanliness, safety, and comfort.

•	Oversee the day-to-day operations of the restaurant and licensed bar, ensuring quality customer service, efficient service delivery, and compliance with responsible service requirements.

•	Coordinate staffing, prepare work rosters, supervise employees, and provide ongoing training to maintain high operational and customer service standards.

•	Monitor guest feedback, promptly resolve customer enquiries and complaints, and implement service improvements to enhance guest satisfaction and encourage repeat business.

•	Manage purchasing, inventory, supplier relationships, and operational expenditure to support efficient business operations and cost control.

•	Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety legislation, food safety requirements, liquor licensing regulations, and other relevant statutory obligations.

•	Oversee the general upkeep, maintenance, and security of motel facilities by coordinating repairs, preventative maintenance, and contractor services where required.

•	Monitor operational performance, prepare reports, and implement strategies to improve occupancy, revenue, and overall business efficiency.

•	Provide guests with information about local attractions, tourism opportunities, and travel services to enhance their overall stay and customer experience.

Qualifications:

•	Diploma or higher qualification in Hospitality Management, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.

•	Minimum 1 year experience in motel, hotel, or hospitality management.

Skills & Experience

•	Strong knowledge of accommodation operations, guest services, food and beverage management, and hospitality best practices.

•	Sound understanding of Australian workplace health and safety, food safety, and liquor licensing requirements.

•	Excellent leadership, organisational, financial, and problem-solving skills.

•	Strong communication and customer service abilities with a commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences.

•	Ability to lead a multidisciplinary hospitality team and manage multiple operational priorities in a fast-paced environment.

If you are a motivated hospitality professional with a passion for delivering outstanding guest experiences and leading successful accommodation operations, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity with Cue Roadhouse.

Interested applicant may submit their application to recruit@gvrc.com.au. Please note that only shortlisted candidate will be contacted.
